fields.System.Title: FDN-304 — API clients for machine callers
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want the ERP and scanner app to authenticate as machine
clients, so that their actions are attributable without pretending to be a person.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a registered API client, when it authenticates with its credentials, then it
  • receives a token identifying it as a client, not a user.
  • - Given an API client, then it has its own permission set, separate from human roles.
  • - Given an action by an API client, then the audit row records the client ID.
  • - Given a revoked client, then its existing tokens stop working.
  • - Given a client credential, then it can be rotated without downtime.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | api_client, audit_log |
| Risks | Machine callers sharing a human account makes audit meaningless |
| Tests | unit · integration |
